name: life-compass
description: Static build for the Life Compass site. No bundler: Node runs the TypeScript build directly (type stripping), and the published site is plain HTML and CSS. See docs/decisions/0003.

scripts.//test: `ls` first so a zero-match glob fails the script. `node --test` exits 0 when its glob matches nothing, so a renamed or moved suite would report success having run no tests at all.
